Sofia (Solutions): Adding a new matrix column: "compatibility-caveats" to note quantization and streaming tradeoffs. Also including a sample commit row in pricing-commit-sample.csv: commit=100k_tokens/day, burst=up-to-2x, baseline-latency=150ms.
Ravi (AE): Nice. Ethan, can you attach the SOC2 excerpt pointer and note on audit logs? They asked explicitly about audit trails.
Ethan (Security): Done — security-note.txt updated with pointer to SOC2 section 2.3 and audit-log retention policy (90 days default, extended on request).
